verdict.rationale: Qapita is a SaaS cap table and equity management platform that holds sensitive customer data, so a policy or control preventing that data from being used for AI model training is a fair privacy question. The evidence pack covers only equity, valuation and reporting features, with no AI-training opt-out, data-use policy or privacy control documented.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
